subject: Ten days from tonight.
text:
Hi,

You've never held one of our pieces. If I were you, that's what would hold me back; the pictures are made, not photographed, and I'm asking you to trust that the knit is as soft as it looks. That's a lot to ask of someone I haven't met, and I can ask it only for a while: the Autumn Sale has an end date, and your 15% sits on top of it until then.

So we carry the risk, not you. Order the coat, or the dress, or the trousers. It's at your door in 7–10 days. Try it on at home, in your own mirror, for up to thirty days. If it isn't right, send it back, easy returns, and you get every dollar back. No questions, no forms that take an afternoon.

Your 15% is still waiting: WELCOME15 at checkout, on top of the 45% Autumn Sale.

https://nora-lanelle.com/discount/WELCOME15?redirect=/collections/all-products

Thank you for reading this far. It means something to a small brand.

Claire
Nora Lanelle

Claire
Nora Lanelle
